name: Upscayl
tagline: Free offline AI image upscaler using Vulkan-accelerated Real-ESRGAN models
real_test_summary: Upscaled a batch of 20 1080p product images by 4x using RealESRGAN on a MacBook Air M2 in ~24 seconds completely offline.
pros: Native desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with Vulkan support
Supports batch folder upscaling with zero credit limits
cons: Requires a Vulkan-compatible GPU or Apple Silicon
Does not natively process video files without external scripts
description: Cross-platform desktop application that enlarges and sharpens low-resolution photos up to 4x completely offline using Vulkan-compatible GPUs and Apple Silicon without cloud uploads.
